label: Black Scarab estimated compensation
basis: advertised annual salary, excluding bonus and equity
method: Median of one annual salary-range midpoint per distinct eligible requisition.
eligibility: Reviewed U.S. engineering roles owning robot/autonomy manufacturing processes, tooling, production systems or electronics manufacturing, with complete verified annual USD ranges.
limitations: Small purposive experienced-role sample, including senior/staff technical positions; concentrated in California, with two Skydio requisitions. Not an entry-level rate or representative market median. Structured fields do not consistently identify base pay. No seniority premium inferred.

observations.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Production Systems
observations.sourceClause: The annual base salary range for this position is $205,000 - $240,000 plus equity and comprehensive benefits including medical/dental/vision plans, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid vacation time, paid sick leave, and parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and experience level. The range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position in the noted geographic area. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
observations.scope: Hands-on technical architecture of robot production sequence, fixtures, defect closure and manufacturing metrics. Staff technical role; no direct-report management stated.
